author: Kushal
problem: There are N people, each a child (0 in S) or an adult (1 in S), with weights W. For a real threshold X, a person is predicted to be an adult if their weight is at least X and a child otherwise. Print the maximum number of correct predictions over all X.
bug_description: Compares the weight with the next person's whole (weight, label) tuple instead of its weight, so the count is also taken between two people of equal weight.

comments.accurate: Sweeps a threshold through the sorted weights and keeps the best count of correct predictions
comments.wrong_behavior: Sweeps a threshold through the sorted people one at a time and keeps the best count of correct predictions
comments.wrong_location: Weight-group check verified; check the starting count of adults before the sweep

source.buggy_line: if i+1 >= n or w != people[i+1]:
source.fixed_line: if i+1 >= n or w != people[i+1][0]:
